ell_rot.description: ℓ_rot (space-lattice rotation length / quantum particle diameter; AQD canonical)

ell_rot_m.description: ℓ_rot expressed in meters (alias of ell_rot)

a_m.description: a (VP diameter) in meters (alias of volume_particle_diameter)

proton_radius.description: Proton charge radius used in the AQD proton module (AQD canonical)

proton_radius_m.description: Proton radius expressed in meters (alias of proton_radius)

hbar.description: Reduced Planck constant (CODATA reference value; used for Casimir baseline)

c.description: Speed of light in vacuum (exact SI)

pi.description: π as a fixed string for cross-platform reproducibility

notes: All numeric values are stored as strings to avoid JSON float rounding.
This file is intended to be the single source of truth for numerical constants across the DOI bundle.
If a module intentionally deviates, it must declare: (i) alternative value, (ii) reason (Gate/Lock), (iii) scope of validity.
